keyword: did afroman win his court case
claims: Afroman won his court case on March 18, 2026.
An Ohio jury ruled in favor of Afroman against Adams County sheriff's deputies.
Adams County sheriff's deputies sued Afroman for defamation and invasion of privacy.
Afroman used footage of Adams County sheriff's deputies' 2022 raid on his home in his music videos.
The jury found Afroman not liable for all counts.
The jury rejected the deputies' claims.
The jury cleared Afroman of all liability regarding defamation, false light, and invasion of privacy.
Seven Adams County deputies claimed they suffered humiliation and emotional distress from Afroman's music videos.
Afroman's music video Lemon Pound Cake featured footage of the deputies raiding his home.
The deputies were awarded no damages.
Afroman called the win a victory for freedom of speech and for the people, according to a video from WCPO 9 and a post on Facebook.
